public.note: The reference deployment's day list for 2026-11-19 and its day record as inscribed on chain. The receipts' payments settle on Robinhood Chain (eip155:4663); the record is on BrainChain (eip155:274663, an L3 that settles on Robinhood Chain, public RPC https://rpc.usebrainchain.com). The deployment served this list before day lists carried `records`; the member is included here with the values the deployment uses, and everything else is as served. inscription.data is the event's data as UTF-8, record is that JSON parsed; the record carries two members beyond the five required, brainchain and at.

invalidLines.name: repeated member name written with an escape

repeatedPayment.note: A valid receipt for the payment receipts[0] already covers: a list holding both is invalid.

equalAt.note: Two receipts with the same at: day-list order puts the lower receipt hash first.

findRecord.note: A mocked JSON-RPC chain for findRecord: block n has timestamp closedAt + (n - firstClosedBlock) * secondsPerBlock, so firstClosedBlock is the first block after the day closed. The block numbers and timestamps are made up; the log at block 3719 is the real one from BrainChain (eip155:274663). eth_getLogs answers every log in the block range, so the reader's own checks on address, publisher and kind are what filter.
